character.name: Ela
traits: likes comparing things side by side
character.current_goal: Find out why one public herb bed becomes much wetter than the others after watering.
established_knowledge: LOCKED_TOOL_SHED is only rumored and is not part of Ela's known route.
The public sprinkler heads can be seen from HERB_WALK.
prohibited_knowledge: Ela does not know what is stored inside LOCKED_TOOL_SHED.
Ela does not know any private maintenance schedule.

local_areas.summary: Small family garden bed near the entrance.
Public herb beds with visible sprinkler heads and marked walking path.
Public pond edge visible from the main path.
A locked maintenance shed outside Ela's current knowledge boundary; do not explore it.

current_facts: One mint bed is noticeably wetter than nearby herb beds after the automatic watering cycle.
The sprinkler heads are visible from the public path.
Visitors may look closely but must stay on the marked path.
hidden_facts_not_available_to_story: Private maintenance records are not available to Ela.

opportunity.title: Find why one herb bed gets extra water
opportunity.premise: Ela can compare visible sprinklers and water patterns from HERB_WALK without entering any unknown maintenance area.
opportunity.success_condition: Reach an evidence-supported explanation using visible observations from known public areas.
constraints: Do not invent private maintenance information.
Do not create danger or damage.
An adult may listen but must not solve the problem.

hard_rules: No supernatural explanation unless canon explicitly establishes it.
Character knowledge cannot exceed experienced or explicitly communicated facts.
Story consequences must be supportable by accepted prose evidence.

eligible_context: Ela is learning to compare observations before deciding what caused a problem.
forbidden_reveal: Do not reveal any future reason the locked shed matters.

relevant_memories.summary: Ela once changed her guess about a drooping flower after comparing sun and shade.
relevant_memories.relevance: Supports revising a simple hypothesis; do not retell the old plot.
